steps.title: Prepare lysis plates
steps.instruction: Aliquot 5 µL Lysis Buffer into each well of one or more 96‑well plates; plates may be stored at room temperature for up to 1 week, but check that salts have not precipitated and that the buffer has not evaporated before use.

steps.title: Make Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare enough Lysis Buffer for the number of plates required; 96‑well plates are preferred because the downstream well cleanup (steps 9‑15) is more difficult with 384‑well plates.

steps.title: Sort single cells
steps.instruction: Sort exactly one cell into each well that already contains 5 µL Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Seal and freeze plates
steps.instruction: Immediately seal the plate with an aluminium cold‑storage seal, spin down in a cooled centrifuge for 30 s at maximum speed, place the plate on dry ice and store at –80 °C (up to 6 months).

steps.title: Thaw and spin
steps.instruction: Thaw plates at room temperature for no more than 1 min, then spin 30 s at 1 000 rcf in a centrifuge pre‑cooled to 4 °C.

steps.title: Add clean‑up beads
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Clean‑up Beads to each well (1 : 2 bead‑to‑sample ratio).

steps.title: Prepare reverse transcription mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Reverse Transcription (RT) Mix on ice; if ERCC spike‑ins are used, reduce the water volume accordingly and add the appropriate amount of ERCCs. Mix the PEG‑containing RT Mix very gently.

steps.title: Add RT mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 µL RT Mix into each well; if using an automated liquid‑handling robot (e.g., Formulatrix Mantis), calibrate for the viscous solution.

steps.title: Seal, vortex and spin
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a PCR seal, vortex briefly, then spin 30 s at 1 000 rcf in a centrifuge pre‑cooled to 4 °C.

steps.title: Pool wells and add binding buffer
steps.instruction: Pool all wells (including beads) of one plate into a 2 mL tube and add 960 µL Bead Binding Buffer (1 : 1 ratio). Vortex to mix.

steps.title: Bind cDNA to beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 min to allow cDNA to bind to the beads.

steps.title: Magnet separation
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic stand until the solution is clear.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (first)
steps.instruction: While on the magnet, wash twice with 2 mL 80 % ethanol, discarding the supernatant each time.

steps.title: Elute cDNA (first)
steps.instruction: Elute the cDNA in 17 µL UltraPure Water, transfer to a new tube and avoid transferring any beads.

steps.title: Exonuclease I digestion
steps.instruction: To the 17 µL cDNA, add 10 µL 10× Exonuclease I Buffer and 1 µL Exonuclease I (20 U/µL); mix gently.

steps.title: Add pre‑amplification mix
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL PreAmplification Mix directly to the Exonuclease I‑treated sample.

steps.title: Prepare clean‑up beads stock
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL Falcon tube combine all bead‑stock ingredients except water; do not add the total water until PEG is fully dissolved. Incubate at 40 °C, vortex regularly until PEG is completely solubilised. Resuspend Sera‑Mag Speed Beads, pipette 1 000 µL bead suspension into a 1.5 mL tube, place on magnet, discard supernatant, add 1 000 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 + 1 mM EDTA (TE) and resuspend beads. Repeat the magnet‑wash once more, then add 900 µL TE, resuspend, and finally add the bead suspension to the PEG solution and mix well. Store the prepared beads at 4 °C or room temperature.

steps.title: Clean‑up after pre‑amp
steps.instruction: Mix the PreAmplification PCR with 40 µL Clean‑up Beads (1 : 0.8 ratio).

steps.title: Magnet and ethanol washes (second)
steps.instruction: Place on magnet until clear, discard supernatant, then wash twice with 150 µL 80 % ethanol (while on magnet) and discard the supernatant each time.

steps.title: Elute cDNA (second)
steps.instruction: Elute the purified cDNA in 15 µL UltraPure Water and transfer to a new tube.

steps.title: Quantify cDNA
steps.instruction: Measure cDNA concentration using the Quant‑iT PicoGreen dsDNA assay kit or an equivalent Qubit assay; use 1 µL of the clean cDNA for the assay. Expected concentration > 1 ng/µL (depends on cell type and PCR cycle number).

steps.title: Optional Bioanalyzer check
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of the cDNA on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with High Sensitivity DNA Analysis Kits.

steps.title: Prepare tagmentation mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Tagmentation Mix according to the kit instructions and dispense 19 µL into each well of a new 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add diluted cDNA
steps.instruction: Dilute the cDNA to 0.8 ng/µL and add 1 µL of this dilution to each tagmentation reaction.

steps.title: Stop tagmentation
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL NT Buffer to each reaction, mix by pipetting up and down, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Add 3' enrichment PCR mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the 3′ Enrichment PCR Mix and add 24.5 µL to each tagmentation reaction.

steps.title: Add i7 index primer
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 µL i7 index primer (5 µM) to each reaction.

steps.title: Clean‑up index PCR
steps.instruction: Mix the Index PCR with 50 µL Clean‑up Beads (1 : 1 ratio).

steps.title: Magnet and ethanol washes (third)
steps.instruction: Place on magnet until clear, discard supernatant, then wash twice with 150 µL 80 % ethanol (while on magnet) and discard the supernatant each time.

steps.title: Elute final library
steps.instruction: Elute the final library in 20 µL UltraPure Water and transfer to a new tube.

steps.title: Run agarose gel
steps.instruction: Load the complete library onto a 2 % Agarose E‑Gel EX and run for 10 min.

steps.title: Excise library fragment
steps.instruction: Open the gel framing with a gel‑opening tool, then excise the library band ranging from 300 bp to 900 bp using a clean scalpel.

steps.title: QC library on Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Quantify and quality‑control the excised library on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with High Sensitivity DNA kits; load both the library and a 1/10 dilution on two separate lanes. Successful libraries typically exceed 3‑5 ng/µL.

steps.title: Sequence library
steps.instruction: Sequence the library on any compatible Illumina platform. Dilute libraries to the recommended molarity (e.g., 2 nM). Use paired‑end settings: Read 1 = 16 cycles (cell barcode + UMI), Index 1 = 8 cycles (i7), Index 2 = 0 cycles, Read 2 = 50 cycles (cDNA fragment).

steps.title: Install zUMIs
steps.instruction: Download and install zUMIs (Linux) from https://github.com/sdparekh/zUMIs, including all dependencies.

steps.title: Generate FASTQ files
steps.instruction: Copy the sequencing data from the sequencer and run bcl2fastq without demultiplexing: `bcl2fastq --use-bases-mask Y16,I8,Y50 --create-fastq-for-index-reads`.

steps.title: Run zUMIs analysis
steps.instruction:
Execute zUMIs with a YAML configuration file (or the Rshiny app). An example YAML is provided below:

```yaml
project: Example_project_name
sequence_files:
  file1:
    name: /data/R2.fq.gz
    base_definition: BC(1-8)
  file2:
    name: /data/R1.fq.gz
    base_definition: - BC(1-6) - UMI(7-16)
  file3:
    name: /data/R3.fq.gz
    base_definition: cDNA(1-50)
reference:
  STAR_index: /data/STAR5idx
  GTF_file: /data/Species.gtf
additional_STAR_params: ''
additional_files: /data/ERCC92.fa
out_dir: /data/zUMIs2/zUMIs
read_layout: SE
num_threads: 15
filter_cutoffs:
  BC_filter:
    num_bases: 1
    phred: 20
  UMI_filter:
    num_bases: 1
    phred: 20
barcode_file: /data/bc.txt
automatic: no
BarcodeBinning: 0
nReadsperCell: 100
counting_opts:
  introns: yes
  downsampling: '0'
  strand: 0
  Ham_Dist: 0
  velocyto: no
  primaryHit: yes
  twoPass: yes
make_stats: yes
which_Stage: Filtering
Rscript_exec: Rscript
STAR_exec: STAR
pigz_exec: pigz
samtools_exec: samtools
```

steps.title: Final bead‑lysate vortex
steps.instruction: Seal the plate, vortex to mix the bead‑lysate mixture, then spin briefly (<200 rcf, <10 s) so the mixture settles at the bottom while beads remain in suspension.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the beads on the magnet for 5 min at room temperature (drying time may vary with laboratory temperature and humidity).

steps.title: Ethanol washes (fourth)
steps.instruction: While on the magnet, wash twice with 50 µL 80 % ethanol, discarding the supernatant each time.

steps.title: Magnet clear
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a magnetic stand until the solution is clear.

steps.title: Incubate binding
steps.instruction: Incubate for 5 min at room temperature to allow cDNA to bind to the beads.

steps.title: Add water and primer
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL H₂O to each well, then add 1 µL barcoded oligo‑dT primer (2 µM, E3V6NEXT adapter).

steps.title: Final mix and spin
steps.instruction: Vortex to mix the bead‑cDNA mixture and spin briefly (<200 rcf, <10 s) so the mixture settles at the bottom while beads stay in solution.

steps.title: Prepare bead binding buffer
steps.instruction: Combine all bead‑binding‑buffer ingredients in a 50 mL Falcon tube, withholding the total water volume until PEG is fully solubilised. Incubate at 40 °C and vortex regularly until PEG is completely dissolved.
